Q: Issue with image on tooltip Plotly/Dash A:

The issue is that you're passing the entire <img> HTML tag as the src attribute.
did you try like this- img1 = "data:image/...", not img1 = "<img src='data:image..> (your current code)

Then use it directly in html.Img(src=img1). When you do html.Img(src=img1) with your original code, you can create <img src="<img src='data:...'>"> I think.

Q: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE not working on Android TV? A:

Since there is no answer for a month, I will answer my question.

After testing on multiple versions of Android TV in emulator, I found that MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is only available in Android TV 13 to 16, not in Android TV 11 and 12.
